product.description:
Landscape and Long Exposure 

4 Days 3 nights  Photography Weekend in Gerrigong/Berry

Sun 17, 18, 19  20 Nov 2024

FULL PRICE: $1860

DEPOSIT: $440



LANDSCAPE and NATURE PHOTOGRAPHY

Immerse yourself in a weekend of learning, exploring and sharing creative energy in Landscape and Seascape photography in the beautiful surrounds of Gerringong, Berry and Kiama districts only  2 - 2.5hrs south of Sydney.

This weekend concentrates on gaining confidence by learning the art of composing, assessing light, and achieving well exposed and dynamic images. We will also we looking at developing a series work in one of these genres this weekend.

Arts photographer Sharon Hickey and owner of The Aperture Club will reveal her insider tips and demonstrate ways of working mindfully in a variety of locations along with Landscape and Nature expert Sara Corlis.

We explore the use of light in landscape and nature photography and learn important elements of composition and its relationship with form. We will also be spending time evaluating our work and learning new ideas and concepts from well known natural photographers.

This is a unique opportunity to work with a professional photographers in an outdoor environment in an area inspired by many great artists and photographers.

Berry is surrounded by breathtaking flora and fauna and is located 2.30 hrs south of Sydney.. From spectacular ocean beaches through to rainforests and waterways Berry has a wealth of beautiful locations for us to explore and capture.

Arrive early if you wish and do nothing else but relax, meet wonderful people, indulge in great photography and explore this amazing landscape.

We work in a small group 6 to 8. We will take 10 but will have 2 tutors available.

Check out our Gallery of Photos made our last trip.

WORKSHOP FORMAT

DATE: 17,18, 19, 20 Nov 2024

LOCATION: Berry Area 2.5hrs south of Sydney

GROUP SIZE: Minimum 4 - Maximum 8 participants.


 WORKSHOP INVESTMENT

·  Weekend for $1320 Tuition Only 

·  Accomodation $540 Only $180per night Corporate Rate

   TOTAL $1860


   Secure your place with a deposit - $440. The Balance due 4 weeks before Workshop date.


ACCOMODATION

We stay at THE MERCURE HOTEL in Gerringong, which offers spacious and beautiful rooms. The hotel offers a lovely restaurant and bar area to relax and swimming and spa facilities to really unwind. The Mercure have given us a good rate and also a wonderful place to edit our work and for tutorials.

We have secured a corporate rate and per room is $180 a night even for the Saturday night!- so we are being looked after! If you wish to spend any extra nights these will be accommodated at the corporate rate.

I have put aside 10 rooms so once you have booked your trip with us please call and book your room which are held  under The Aperture Club.

The Mecure Hotel Info

https://www.mercuregerringong.com.au/


WHAT THE
WORKSHOP COVER

·       Creative camera controls

        Long Exposure methods

·       Advanced creative composition

·       Understanding light

·       Working with filters

·       Creative idea development

·       Setting mood and creating atmosphere

·       Developing personal style

        Painting with Light


DAILY PROGRAM: - Can change daily

The program gives you the opportunity to shoot 3 sunrises and 3 sunsets and a night shoot.

This is incorporated with some lectures, editing sessions  and possible extra day time shoots.

There is some time to explore the township go for a beach swim and also relax.

This is an immersive few days of photography and the aim is to think and feel photography whilst developing your individual approach and ideas.


Note schedule can be altered depending on everyone's needs etc. and is suitable for all levels of photographic skills.

 

WALKING AND WEATHER

This is a gentle trip, which requires a low level of fitness.  There will be a small amount of walking to and from 
locations, occasionally on uneven surfaces with steps and inclines.  If you have any doubts about your ability, please contact Sharon directly.  

When you book you will receive a detailed packing list to help you plan.

 

MEALS

Meals are not included in the tuition price but we will look at affordable and enjoyable options.

There are plenty of cafes and restaurants around that suits all dietry needs and we can organise a picnic lunch if we so desire.

Approx dinner costs excl drinks $25 - $35. 

BYO Alcohol to hotel or bar available.


TRANSPORT

Car: Make your own way directly to Berry. Car sharing might be an option.

Train: We are happy to organise pick up and drop offs to local train station. It's a very pleasant train journey from Central station.

Most of our clients prefer to have their own transport for this workshop, so that they can come and go from Berry depending on their time frame.

We will try to condense our outings to a couple of vehicles only on our photography outings depending on numbers. Whilst there I can take 3 to 4 people in my car and the same in Sara's car.

 

WHAT TO BRING

·     Camera equipment

·     Tripod

·      Laptop with latest Adobe Lightroom Classic software (recommended) or a
       tablet with image processing software (Snapseed or Lightroom)

·      Wet weather clothing? Check weather forecast

·      Wind jacket for early morning adventures

·      Sturdy footwear

·      Day pack/camera pack

·      Torch

·      Water bottle

·      Please make sure you have booked your accommodation prior to the workshop


TESTAMONIALS

I can highly recommend the Berry photography weekend away, lots of variety, one on one input, relaxed atmosphere, high quality accomodation and meals, learn at your own pace, suitable for all levels.

Tracye Hughs


We look forward to welcoming you on our photography workshop very soon.


Sharon and The Aperture Club Team

 

Contacts:

Sharon: 0411 370577

Email: info@theapertureclub.com.au

TERMS AND CONDITIONS


1.  Payment options
To confirm your booking, we require a deposit payable via our website.  The deposit amount will vary between courses, workshops and tours so please read carefully through the information available on the web page for each offering.  
The balance is due  4 weeks (30 days) prior to your program.  We prefer payment by direct deposit.  
2.  Cancellation and Refund Policy 
All deposits for workshops or tour fees are non-refundable. 
THE APERTURE CLUB is a very small business and relies on bookings for planning out the year. Your booking is your promise to go ahead with the workshop, your place which we hold for you, and book venues and staff based on bookings. Deposits are your booking fee and are treated as such.
For cancellations up to three months before the start date of your program you will forfeit your deposit (booking fee).  
For cancellations within two months of the start date of your program you will forfeit the full fee payable.  
In the event The Aperture Club is required to cancel a course, workshop, or tour we will endeavour to reschedule the program on a date that suits all participants.  If this is not possible, we will offer participants an alternative program to the same value.  Credits and refunds will be given at the discretion of The Aperture Club. 
The Aperture Club is not in any way liable for any personal costs associated with the cancellation.
Under some exceptional circumstances tours or workshops may be cancelled or terminated without notice or during the program.  The Aperture Club will relocate or reschedule as necessary.  Credits and refunds will be given at the discretion of The Aperture Club.  
 
3.  Losses and damages
Please take responsibility for your personal equipment.  The Aperture Club is not liable for equipment damages or losses (including theft) during your course, workshop, or tour. This includes damage to equipment whilst following procedures outlined during the course. Damages may include but are not limited to - sensor, camera, and lens cleaning. If in doubt pay an expert to perform these delicate operations on your valuable equipment. The Aperture Club recommends having your photographic equipment insured during the workshop.
 
4.  Limitation of Liability
The Aperture Club is not liable for any extraneous expenses relating to your booking with us.  While The Aperture Club will take all reasonable measures to keep you informed and relocate or reschedule any programs affected by unforeseen circumstances, we will take no responsibility for costs incurred when this is impossible.  
Our programs may be affected by weather, fire, flood, theft, criminal activity, political disputes, acts of terrorism, strikes, sickness, failure of flights or other transportation to arrive or depart on time, and other causes beyond our control.  
Costs may include but are not limited to cancellations, missing connecting transport, extra accommodation, or food expenses. 
 
5.  Acknowledgement of Risk
Photography and outdoor activities possess inherent risks, as detailed in our waiver form. 
It is a condition of attendance on The Aperture Clubs programs that all tour and workshop participants complete and submit an acknowledgement of risk, waiver of liability and medical form.
If in doubt about your health or fitness please contact The Aperture Club to discuss the requirements and consult your physician for advice.
 
6.  Transport, Accommodation, Itinerary
The Aperture Club reserves the right to alter accommodation venues, vehicles and itineraries of workshops and tours without notice. The Aperture Club is not responsible for your vehicle or for clients travelling in other clients’ vehicles.
 
7.  Medical and Travel Insurance
It is a requirement that all domestic and international tour participants purchase personal medical and travel insurance (including cancellation cover) for the duration of the tour. 
The Aperture Club is not liable for ambulance, evacuation or medical costs associated with accidents incurred during the tour or workshop. Travel insurance will also cover you for your equipment, cancellations, airfares, luggage, and public liability (see individual policies for specific details).  We also recommend that all attendees on outdoor photography programs have personal medical insurance and ambulance cover.  
 



8.  Media waiver
The Aperture Club requests that all program participants sign a media waiver permitting our use of any photographs or video footage taken of you during your time with us.  Uses may include but are not limited to our website, promotional material, social media, or presentations.  

9.  Removal from program
The Aperture Club reserves the right to remove any member of any trip should such person’s actions disrupt the operation of the trip or the rights, safety, or enjoyment of other members of the trip. No refunds will be given in such circumstances, nor will The Aperture Club be liable for any costs associated with being removed, nor with your return home.
